//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Persistent Inventory Search -> Config

Enable Persistent Inventory Search.//: Whether Persistent Inventory Search is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

keepSearchQuery.//: Whether the creative search query is kept when switching tabs or closing the inventory.

selectKeptSearchQuery.//: Whether the kept search query is selected, so typing a new search replaces it.

keepSearchTabScrollPosition.//: Whether the search tab keeps its scroll position.

keepOtherTabsScrollPosition.//: Whether the other creative tabs keep their scroll position.
